note: What the Hiro fee estimator would quote a wallet for one xchess submit, sampled every 20 seconds.
why: The rebate has to cover what a WALLET charges a human, not what the tournament runner pays. The runner pays 400 uSTX because it can replace its own transaction; a board cannot.
chosenRebateNote: Set here because 78% of middle quotes are at or below it. The rest are what the 0.25 STX bootstrap is for.
